parameters: text: "Alright, kids. Time for today's lesson."
text: "I know I go over the same boring things so~ I will keep doing that, okay?"
text: "Today's lesson is the usual. Survive, adapt and trust the person beside you."
text: "Because someday... that's all you're going to have."
text: "If that's what you think is best for us Instructor, then I'm ready."
text: "Honestly, I do hope that there is some sort of pay off by the end of this."
text: "Don't worry Miss Fourth, I plan to teach you kids many things by the end of the school year but..."
text: "Let's begin with the training, shall we?"
text: "First things first... I want you all to hit me."
text: "Any volunteers? I won't immediately attack back this time."
Cards are the primary way to do battle. As long as your EP meets the requirement, you will be able to use the cards.
Every battle the default EP starts at 3 and caps at 10. To gain more EP you can use a card or item that restores it.
The damage from cards is determined by your ATK stat multiplied by the value the card description shows.
You can check your stats by clicking the character's icon which also reveals any states that may be affecting you at present, alongside character passives if they have one.
Go ahead and give the Instructor an attack.
Johan instructs to let Soran take a swing at it.
text: "That's the spirit! Extra points for taking the initiative, Miss Fourth."
text: "Now, in combat there's no way you'll always to be able to avoid every attack."
text: "I'm going to retaliate soon so Soran, Silica, you should put your guards up."
Every battle and turn, by default, characters start with 0 block.
The value of block can be stagnant or calculated through your defense stat. The multiplier works the same
as the damaging cards. By having block, it reduces the damage taken during damage calculations
so it could really save you in a pinch!
Enemy block does NOT reset after every turn.
Block can be obtained via cards, items or equipment. Additionally, Block does NOT carry over between turns
You can check the predicted damage by clicking the enemy sprite. Additionally, you can see the states they are
being affected by and a description of their skills.
text: "Amazing teamwork! Remember, you're all a team so you need to look out for each other.."
text: "Now... allow me to see how well you can withstand this."
text: "Did that hurt? Haha, my bad. However, there are ways to heal up those scratches."
text: "Miss Fourth, I'm sure you're capable of doing that but just in case..."
text: "If you have an arte available that heals you should definitely use it... "
text: "Despite how you may feel about using orbal energy."
Every character can heal which is scaled off their "Healing Power."
Not every character will have access to healing, normally, but with certain cards they can
obtain the power to heal themselves or allies.
Make sure to keep your allies healthy in case for huge attacks that could easily knock them out.
text: "Feeling a little better? That's good. Do monitor yourselves while in battle."
text: "Hesitation can be lethal in a real fight."
text: "Instructor Johan, is there a way we can possibly dodge incoming attacks?"
text: "Great question! While it is possible you may need some assitance to increase those odds."
text: "And I know just the boy for that... Owayne! Come here, you!"
text: "Uhh... Instructor. Are you sure I'm the right guy for this?"
text: "Sure you are! That bow Leticia made for you will do just the trick."
Aside from Block and Healing another way to reduce damage is to not take any at all!
Characters can obtain an "Evasion Rate" which increases the odds of being hit.
There are also some skills that will outright dodge for you.
Using skills that increase evasion rate can help in situations where an attack seems near hopeless to defend!

text: "Look at that! And I even went double strength there!"
text: "No matter how strong an attack, if you have tools to evade, do it."
text: "But if I didn't know any better, that bow can do one more thing... right?"
text: "But if I didn't know any better, that bow can do one more thing... right?"
text: "Y-Yeah. Leticia installed an orbal core that unleashes a burst of ener---"
text: "YOU WANT ME TO USE IT ON YOU!?"
text: "That's right. You're going to have to use it at some point, when in a pinch."
text: "I'm sure the Instructor is capable to defend against it, it's okay, Owayne."
text: "...And if he doesn't then it just shows he's all talk."
text: "Well it takes time to charge, just give me a moment."
text: "Alright, then defend against me until then!"
Characters possess a skill card known as a "S-Craft" which you can consider as an ultimate move.
They can be offensive or supportive.
You cannot use a S-Craft unless the Craft Points (CP) is at the required amount.
CP starts at 2 at the start of every battle and normally increases by 1 every turn.
Craft Points in general has another use but this will be covered in the near future.
Once a S-Craft is used it will be removed from play for the rest of the battle. So use them if you absolutely must!
text: "Splendid! I'm looking for to this then."
text: "I will say, Juel Owayne, don't always rely on it. Orbal technology is quite dangerous. "
text: "I know but I just want to make sure I'm using it right."
text: "There's only one way to find out."
text: "That's right. Show us your stuff, Owayne."

text: "Well! Looks like that's the end of today's lesson. Hope you learned something."
text: "Unfortunately, it's the same lesson once again."
text: "Just a little different but perhaps there's a deeper meaning?"
text: "Or to make sure we don't ever forget."
text: "Haha. This will definitely come in handy for all you kids later."
